name: earshot
description: Kettlehole Audio Earshot: adaptive-audio portfolio and booking console

scripts.build: npm run check && npm run build:server && vite build
scripts.build:server: esbuild server/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/server/main.js --external:pg-native --external:cloudflare:sockets --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
